title: Gelato Base Ingredients
howto_lede: For every Starter Pack ingredient we name a product you can buy in this country.

steps.p: The first is our pick; the second is an alternative if the first is not available.
The ingredients on the pack must match the description of the item. Where a product's composition differs, we say so.

steps.b: Take the amounts from the app
steps.p: This PDF names products, not gram amounts. Recipes and amounts are calculated by the Gellatti app.

legend.from_abroad: a shop abroad that delivers to this country
legend.b2b: sold to businesses or in large packs
legend.other_composition: the same kind of product with a different composition (shown next to it)
legend.alternative: a substitute for another Gellatti product

INU.name: Inulin
INU.ref: Inulin powder, for example from chicory.

STB.name: Stabilizer
STB.ref: Gellatti Stabilizer is a blend of tara gum, locust bean gum and guar gum.

stabilizer_note: A local alternative to the Gellatti blend, not the same blend. Mix it with the dry ingredients and heat the base to 75–80 °C.
missing: No approved product in this country yet.

notes.p: We checked these products on manufacturer and shop websites in September 2026. Availability, prices and delivery can change and are not guaranteed.
Before you buy, check the ingredients and allergens on the pack. Cream powder and milk powder contain milk; egg yolk contains egg.
In this country, a local plant gum replaces the Gellatti Stabilizer. It works in a similar way but is not the same blend.

fine: A product named here is not necessarily available in the Gellatti app yet. Gellatti does not sell other brands' products.
back_h: Great gelato starts with a good base.
back_p: Recipes, amounts and the process are in the Gellatti app.
